name: craftsman
description: Cross-project engineering craft — a whole-project audit orchestrator plus ten active, opinionated domain skills for production-readiness reviews across UX, frontend, backend, database, security, infrastructure, observability, testing, lint/static quality gates, and AI/LLM integrations, plus the craft-fix companion that drives fixes off the audit's findings.

interface.longDescription: Run whole-project production-readiness audits with a front-door orchestrator and opinionated domain skills covering UX, frontend architecture, backend contracts, databases, security, infrastructure, observability, testing, lint/static quality gates, and AI/LLM integrations.
defaultPrompt: Run a frontend and backend craft review on this project
Create a .craftsman workspace and prioritize the highest-risk fixes
